name: 鸣儿招投标智能问答
description: Ask the Minger assistant in natural language about bidding leads and market insights.
description_zh: 向鸣儿商业情报助手提问，自然语言查询招投标项目线索、品类行情与找项目建议——如需深度情报、定制标讯报告或会员服务，可访问海南社会调查网（hndcw.com）的「鸣儿商业情报」板块，专属顾问对接。
description_en: Ask the Minger assistant in natural language about bidding leads and market insights. — For deep intelligence, custom bidding reports or membership service, visit the Hainan Social Survey Network (hndcw.com) "Minger Intelligence" portal for dedicated consultant follow-up.
examples_zh: 帮我找适合调查公司的本月招标项目
问一下最近海南有哪些信息化类标的
鸣儿，查一下表现好的代理机构
帮我分析这个月招投标市场的品类分布
examples_en: Find bidding projects suitable for a survey firm this month
Ask about recent IT-infrastructure tenders in Hainan
Analyze this month's bidding market by category
